prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square seamless albedo-only source tile for a low-poly fantasy architectural material
Primary request: Create a subtle reusable jade-green masonry albedo for serpent-city temples, water shrines and selected monumental trim.
Style/medium: restrained painterly low-poly fantasy architecture material consistent with Eloria's approved muted ground/desert artwork; readable stone surface, not ornate concept art.
Composition/framing: perfectly flat orthographic square wall tile with medium coursed rectangular blocks; courses extend and wrap seamlessly across left-right and top-bottom edges. The final block row and joint positions at the top edge must continue exactly at the bottom edge; no top/bottom cap, outer frame, scene presentation edge or focal block.
Color palette: subdued mineral jade, muted green-grey, olive-grey and soft weathered pale-stone variation; low saturation, not emerald or bright turquoise.
Materials/textures: carefully laid aged masonry with varied block lengths, softly worn arrises, shallow restrained joints, faint mineral mottling and occasional gentle tonal variation. Intended architectural repeat about 2 metres; moderate low-contrast detail.
Lighting/mood: uniform neutral diffuse albedo only, perfectly even at tile boundaries.
Constraints: tile wraps invisibly on both axes including the horizontal course rhythm; color only, no normal/height/roughness cues, carving, relief or ornament.
Avoid: course discontinuity at top/bottom, border, frame, presentation margin, stark dark grout, crisp grid, high contrast, decorative motifs, serpent symbols, inscriptions, inlays, precious gems, cracks, rubble, plants, directional shadows, highlights, gradients, perspective, horizon, text, logo, watermark.
